verdict.rationale: Skyvern's own approach maps visual elements to actions on sites it has never seen and uses LLMs plus computer vision. It also applies a vision model to CAPTCHAs, so screenshot-based perception is part of the product. However, nothing documents a selectable vision or computer-use action mode that operates purely on screenshots, and the SDK is described as layering AI onto Playwright over CDP. missing for 10: a documented switchable vision/computer-use mode, coordinate-level screenshot actions for canvases and non-DOM UIs, API/SDK parameters to select the mode, and hands-on corroboration.
